description: For research modes (deep research, company knowledge). In chat, use get_guide instead. Returns the full text of one item from search: a guide section ("<locale>/<slug>#<anchor>"), an article look ("look:<id>") or a colour-season palette page ("season:<season>").

locale.description: The user's language as a language tag, e.g. "de" or "pt-BR". Set it from the user's language. Defaults to English.

name: fetch
title: Fetch BeautySpark content (research)
